term: fixed-agent world-indexed K versus distributed someone/sometime knowledge
resolution: The generic Context may interpret K in different ways only when its laws are supplied. The survivor uses the existing fixed-agent relational Knows. The CC100-124 possible-someone and contextual/literal actual-someone readings are not identified with that box. Distributed some-agent/sometime K inherits factivity and left-conjunct extraction from each witness when truth refers to the same content/world; it never yields a common agent/time across propositions. No F6 epistemic-reason premise supplies knowability. Modal R and epistemic E remain distinct; the survivor has E not contained in R.
